The upstream a14 also has the same order (projekts before settings). Let me check the upstream a14 map_location.rb — maybe in upstream a14 `set_default_values` is different (the `default ? Setting[...]` part). The local repo at this SHA has a `default` boolean flag on MapLocation — `MapLocation.default` runs `find_or_create_by!(default: true)`.

Wait — let me actually re-read this. `MapLocation.find_or_create_by!(default: true)` creates a new MapLocation with default: true, but with no latitude/longitude/zoom. Then `set_default_values` runs on that new record: mappable is nil (mappable isn't required? the `belongs_to :mappable, polymorphic: true, touch: true` — in the app belongs_to_required_by_default is set to false, so mappable can be nil). Then it falls through to the final else: `self.latitude ||= default ? Setting["map.latitude"] : self.class.default.latitude`. Here `default` is true, so it becomes Setting["map.latitude"]. If Setting["map.latitude"] is nil → latitude stays nil → validation fails on create!.

So the fix is: create the `map.latitude`, `map.longitude`, `map.zoom` settings before projekt creation. dev_seeds/settings.rb probably creates those. Upstream a14 is the same code... hmm, so how does the upstream seed work? Let me check whether upstream a14's settings seed includes map.latitude. And whether the settings seed creates them. If the upstream seed also fails the same way, then the guide's `db:dev_seed` is broken on this commit (documented behavior).

Let me check upstream a14's dev_seeds/settings.rb and dev_seeds.rb in their entirety, and compare with local. Actually there's an easier way: check the local settings seed for the map.* keys.
